title: Extract interfaces for MemoryIndex, MemoryScorer, and MemoryStateMachine
description: MemoryIndex, MemoryScorer (static class), and MemoryStateMachine have no interfaces (IMemoryIndex, IMemoryScorer, IMemoryStateMachine). None can be mocked in tests or DI-substituted. Extract interfaces for all three, convert MemoryScorer from static to instance, register in DI. This enables unit testing of scoring, indexing, and state machine logic without real implementations. Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P2-009
